turns.text: Yeah, the one just a block away. It was super busy, but totally worth the wait.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: I bet! It's prime soup season. How is your roommate Sam doing? Have you two been keeping warm?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Sam is doing great. We actually hung out in the living room last night, and I played some guitar while we just caught up on our week.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That sounds like a really nice, relaxing evening. Have things finally settled down for you since traveling for Ana's wedding in San Antonio?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yeah, they have. The wedding was wonderful, but it definitely feels good to be back in Chicago and getting back into my regular routine.
